seo_title: Sharp Story: Branding and packaging for D2C and FMCG brands
hero_heading:
Brands, cut down
to one idea.
hero_text: An independent branding and packaging studio for D2C and FMCG brands.
manifesto_heading:
We cut until
one idea
is left.
manifesto_text: Every strong brand stands on one clear idea. We find it through research, sharpen it through strategy and bring it to life through identity and packaging, so the brand is easy to understand, hard to copy and built to last.
services_heading:
Three disciplines.
One idea running through them.

services.title: Brand strategy
services.line: The thinking everything else stands on.
services.text: We research the business, the market and the people it serves, then define the purpose, positioning and story the brand will own.

services.title: Branding
services.line: An identity people recognise before they read it.
services.text: We turn the strategy into a complete visual and verbal system that holds up everywhere the brand appears.

services.title: Packaging design
services.line: Where the brand is held, opened and judged.
services.text: We design packaging as part of the brand system, from structure and materials to the moment someone opens it.

offers_heading: Four ways to work with us.
offers_text: Start small or build the whole brand. Every offer begins with the same thing: finding the one idea.

offers.name: Shelf Check
offers.text: Your packaging, audited against five competitors on shelf, Amazon and quick-commerce. A clear diagnosis of what’s costing you attention, and what to fix first.

offers.name: Hero Pack
offers.text: One hero product, designed to win. Strategy brief, two creative routes and print-ready packaging for your lead SKU, ready to extend across the range.

offers.name: Launch System
offers.text: Everything a new brand needs to launch properly. Positioning, identity, hero pack, three SKUs and brand guidelines, built as one system.

offers.name: Range Refresh
offers.text: For established brands with a full range. A packaging system that sharpens every SKU while keeping the recall you’ve already earned.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: From 5 days for a Shelf Check to 8–14 weeks for a full range.
Two rounds at each stage. Further rounds are quoted at a day rate.
50% to begin, 30% on route approval, 20% before final files. Prices exclude GST.
We deliver print-ready files and work with your printer on proofs.
Yes. Most clients begin with a Shelf Check, and its fee is credited to the project.
